description: This Java class `LegacyGodparentInfoMessageEvent` extends `LegacyApsAckedCommandEvent` and represents a specific event message related to ZigBee core events, containing methods to construct a command payload for the event.

classes.name: LegacyGodparentInfoMessageEvent
classes.description: Represents a ZigBee event message containing godparent and target device information, capable of generating its command payload.

methods.name: LegacyGodparentInfoMessageEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with given EUI64, endpoint ID, and device numbers.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Constructs and returns the command payload as a byte array, including device numbers, RSSI, and LQI.
